query: For an elemental Cr coating on a zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate, what single intervention could prevent premature coating failure caused by elevated-temperature Cr–Zr interdiffusion while preserving protection under both normal subcritical-water operation and accident-relevant high-temperature steam? Formulate one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains the mechanism, predicts performance relative to the unmodified Cr-coated baseline, defines the relevant temperature, exposure-time, and environmental boundaries, cites supporting prior evidence, and specifies a discriminating experiment and outcome that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The introduction of a thin, dense, and uniform alumina (Al2O3) interlayer between the Cr coating and the zirconium-alloy substrate will prevent premature coating failure caused by elevated-temperature Cr-Zr interdiffusion, while preserving protection under both normal subcritical-water operation and accident-relevant high-temperature steam.
generation.material_initial_state: Elemental Cr coating on a zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate
generation.intervention: Introduction of a thin, dense, and uniform alumina (Al2O3) interlayer between the Cr coating and the zirconium-alloy substrate
generation.conditions: Elevated temperatures up to 1200°C, exposure to subcritical water and high-temperature steam
generation.structural_mediator: The alumina interlayer acts as a diffusion barrier, preventing Cr-Zr interdiffusion
generation.mechanism: The alumina interlayer reduces the interfacial reaction between Cr and Zr, thereby preventing the formation of brittle intermetallic compounds and maintaining the integrity of the Cr coating
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved resistance to premature coating failure, preservation of protection under normal and accident-relevant conditions
generation.boundary: Temperature: up to 1200°C, exposure time: dependent on operating conditions, environment: subcritical water and high-temperature steam
generation.uncertainty: The effectiveness of the alumina interlayer in preventing Cr-Zr interdiffusion may depend on the specific deposition parameters and the resulting microstructure of the interlayer

falsification_experiment.design: Exposure of the Cr-coated substrate with and without the alumina interlayer to elevated temperatures and subcritical water or high-temperature steam, followed by characterization of the coating's microstructure and composition
measurements: Coating thickness, microstructure, and composition, as well as the extent of Cr-Zr interdiffusion
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the alumina interlayer does not prevent Cr-Zr interdiffusion or does not improve the coating's resistance to premature failure, the hypothesis is falsified
